retained_source_pixels: The formal PNG retains unmodified original screenshot RGB beneath its alpha. The new paragraph mask is rebuilt from these original crop pixels, not from a preview or zeroed RGB.
editing_basis: Rebuild paragraph glyphs directly from retained original RGB, including darker internal strokes, then retain one pixel of original antialias/dark edge. BGR, canvas, icon/name RGBA and paragraph-external pixels unchanged. No sharpening, redraw or resizing.
limitations: Only description alpha changes. Runtime icon/name pixels, masks, preprocessed parts, index arrays, canvas and origin are identical; unchanged image-recognition suites are not repeated. No live game test.
validation_reuse: Reused approved candidate-stage checks. PNG/alpha, configuration, ROI and recognition code unchanged; no image scans repeated after approval.
